fills.tieReason: s_00734 shows 85 [wood log] at Baugr Fort. The Baugr Fort card in the same video (s_01936) says it 'reduces Barracks technology costs by 15%'. The cross-check s_00754 shows Turnshoes at Baugr Fort as 85 food / 213 gold, which is exactly 100/250 x 0.85. So base wood = 85/0.85 = 100. This is derived from the frames, not printed directly, and it matches the checklist's 100.

fills.name: Hamrammr
fills.tieReason: s_00734 shows 128 [gold bar] under the same 15% Baugr Fort Barracks-tech discount (s_01936; Turnshoes 250 gold to 213 on s_00754). 150 x 0.85 = 127.5, which rounds to 128. Base gold is 150: derived from the frames, not printed directly, and it matches the checklist's 150.
